items.title: NBX partners Visa for stablecoin-linked card
items.why: Visa is building spend products around stablecoin-linked balances, a signal to watch as issuers weigh multi-money card offerings.
items.summary_ai: Visa, NBX, Tieto and IDT Finance announced plans for a Visa Flex Card that lets NBX customers spend across several forms of money.
items.take: Visa is building spend products around stablecoin-linked balances, a signal to watch as issuers weigh multi-money card offerings.
